name: fx-bail
note: Phase 4/5 bail-out from the high band: a short low hop to warm the flight view, land, re-spawn, then the vehicles bench's fall-pose eval climbs to 5,000 m AGL and bails (free fall ~100 s, the chute at 150 m, touchdown). Checks the falling pose + parachute pack (vehicleFallAnim), the flight view during the fall (player AGL), the cloud high-band march switch on the way up, and the derelict despawn (vehicle_derelict_high_agl).
